content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-82. - Temporary bonds.
content.summary:
Pending preparations of the definitive bonds, temporary bonds in such form and with
               such provisions as the council may determine may be issued.
(Code 1981, § 27-83; Ord. No. 551, § 29(E), 5-14-1964)
